name: snowflake
description: Snowflake data warehouse integration via the Snowflake SQL API and REST catalog — run SQL statements, poll long-running statements by handle, cancel statements, and browse databases, schemas, tables, columns, and warehouses. Authenticates with a Programmatic Access Token (PAT) sent as a static bearer token; no OAuth flow or token endpoint is involved.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Snowflake SQL API and REST catalog via a Programmatic Access Token

fields.label: Programmatic Access Token
fields.helpText: A Snowflake Programmatic Access Token (PAT). Generate one in Snowsight under your user profile, ideally restricted to a single role. Default expiry is 15 days (max 365).

fields.label: Warehouse
fields.helpText: Virtual warehouse used to execute SQL statements (e.g. COMPUTE_WH).

fields.label: Role
fields.helpText: Optional role to assume for statements. Defaults to the token user's default role; must match the PAT's role restriction if one is set.

tools.name: snowflake.query
tools.description: Execute an arbitrary SQL statement on the configured warehouse via the Snowflake SQL API. With the default timeout the statement runs synchronously and returns columns and rows (capped, with a truncation flag); a timeout above 20 seconds submits the statement asynchronously and immediately returns a statement handle to poll with snowflake.get_statement.

statement.description: The SQL statement to execute (single statement)

role.description: Role to run the statement as (optional, overrides the connection's role)

timeout.description: Server-side statement timeout in seconds (default 20, max 3600). Values above 20 submit the statement asynchronously: the tool returns a statement handle immediately — poll it with snowflake.get_statement.

tools.name: snowflake.get_statement
tools.description: Check the status of a previously submitted statement by handle and, when it has completed, fetch and stitch its result partitions into columns and rows (capped, with a truncation flag).

statementHandle.description: The statement handle returned by snowflake.query

tools.name: snowflake.cancel_statement
tools.description: Cancel a running statement by handle.

statementHandle.description: The statement handle of the running statement to cancel

tools.name: snowflake.list_databases
tools.description: List databases visible to the connection's role.

database.description: Database name (case-sensitive if it was created quoted)

tools.name: snowflake.list_tables
tools.description: List tables in a schema, with row counts and sizes.

database.description: Database name (case-sensitive if it was created quoted)

schema.description: Schema name (case-sensitive if it was created quoted)

tools.name: snowflake.describe_table
tools.description: Get a table's detail including its columns (name, datatype, nullability, default, comment) from the REST catalog, falling back to DESCRIBE TABLE via the SQL API when the catalog omits columns.

database.description: Database name (case-sensitive if it was created quoted)

schema.description: Schema name (case-sensitive if it was created quoted)

table.description: Table name (case-sensitive if it was created quoted)

tools.name: snowflake.list_warehouses
tools.description: List virtual warehouses visible to the connection's role, with state, size, and auto-suspend settings.
